title: Console - Billing
content: #### Permission: ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778894911001) Group Admin, Group Operator # **Objective** ![Shape \(2\).png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778923953561) | Access Admin Console by clicking ![mceclip0.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778941057945) icon on your CLO-SET dashboard. Admin Console shows the Group summary, Billing, Data Intelligence, Activity Log, Settings, and Developer Page. ---|--- On the Billing tab, you can review the Group's billing history, invoice, and user history, and usage history. 1. Billing History * Invoice 2. User History * Permission Approval * User Type Change * Email Change 3. Usage History # **Details** ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/49270770558489) **Menu** | **Sub-Menu** | **Details** ---|---|--- Billing | * Billing History * User History * Usage History | View invoice details & group member history. ### 1) Billing History ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778910108057) 1. **Date** (UTC/GMT): Date of the event, recorded in UTC, sorted from latest to oldest 2. **Invoice No.** : Invoice created at each payment cycle. Click to view or print the invoice. 3. **Description** : Plan & User history information. Find more details on [Billing Guideline](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303191886361) 4. **Charges** : Amount billed or paid per the event on description * Positive values (+): indicate paid amount OR credit that can be used for your next payment * Negative values (-): charged to the user to be paid in future 5. **Credit balance** : Remaining credit balance as a result of each event. * Positive values (+): credit that can be used for your next payment * Negative values (-): amount owed to be paid in future * from below image, 1️⃣ ➕ 2️⃣ 🟰 3️⃣ ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778941893529) * ### Invoice * Click on the Invoice no. to print or download your invoice. Please note that the 'To' field will display the user id and email of the account that first initiated the payment (either Group Admin or Group Operator account will be listed). * On the invoice, you can find the list of members that has been charged for the listed subscription period. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778942101913) ### 2) User History #### 1\. Permission Approval * Find the list of permission requests & full list of users approved/pending/rejected from the Group **[All User Status]** Displays the full list of users invited to the Group (including approved, pending, removed) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778925421465) * * **Status** of the accounts are displayed as one of the four below: * Pending: pending request for approval to * Rejected: permission request rejected * Approved: request approved but the user is not registered on CLO-SET * Reapproved: request that had previously been rejected, then approved afterwards * Clicking on the active user's account email to view [Permission Management](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303209418649) info for the selected account **[Pending Users]** Displays the list of requests that are pending/rejected ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778880587033) * Once the new member is approved, the user will be deleted from the 'pending users' tab (but continue to display on the 'all user status' tab) * If the same user has been invited multiple times, approving the user on any 1 of the rows will automatically approve all requests #### 2\. User Type Change * View the full list of changes on Group members that affects your subscription amount. * **For more information on permission by space, visit 'Permission Management' tab within Admin Console.** ![userhis.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778925775897) #### 3\. Email Change * View the list of users within the Group with the email change history. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778942837401) ### 3) Usage History ![Screenshot 2024-11-01 at 6.20.30 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778897328921) * View the Group's feature usage history per measurement period. * User/Company/Workroom is displayed as max count by period * File Upload/Rendering/Embed View/API Call is displayed as total count by period * For more details on how CLO-SET measures each field, visit [Feature Usage Measurement Criteria](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303208104857) * Depending on your group's subscribed plan, there may be restrictions on field usage. Visit [CLO-SET Pricing](https://style.clo-set.com/service/pricing) page to learn more.
content_description: This web page provides Group Admins and Operators with comprehensive access to the Admin Console, allowing them to manage billing, user permissions, and usage history effectively.

title: Console - Developer Page (Trigger)
content: #### Permission: ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778994304025) Group Admin, Group Operator # **Objective** ![Shape \(2\).png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778978701465) | Access Admin Console by clicking ![mceclip0.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778994757017) icon on your CLO-SET dashboard. Admin Console shows the Group summary, Billing, Data Intelligence, Activity Log, Settings, and Developer Page. ---|--- On the Developer Page tab, you can add API Tokens and Triggers. 1. Trigger * Set Sync * Set Render Trigger * Set Webhook 2. API Token Article can be found HERE # **Details** ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778973438361) ![developerpage.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778995119897) ## ### 1) Trigger ### [Set sync] 1\. Enter the URL and click 'Update' button. 2\. Go to style page. You can see the sync button activated. ![style_sync](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/common/images/style_sync.png) 3\. Click sync button to open new tab with the URL you entered above. The new tab's URL contains Style ID, style version, external style ID as query string. ### [Set Render trigger] 1\. Click 'ADD TRIGGER' under Render section. 2\. Choose workflow status that fires the trigger. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778990334233) 3\. Go to Workroom or Style page and change Workflow of style, and refresh your browser to initiate Render. _*Render will be requested with the uploaded file's render properties set in CLO S/W._ ![RenderTrigger.gif](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778990683545) #### Potential Error Cases in Render Trigger Fail * In any case where render cannot be completed, Render Trigger can not also be completed * When file has not completed parsing * When file has failed parsing * When Render Setting is not yet set * Render Setting has to be set in order for Render Trigger to properly work #### Render Properties of CLO3D * Rendering properties can be saved as .zvrp. It can also be opened in CLO3D. ![](https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/IJpthF2Vv7VzUy4yc_9eFfkmHoKt9mGB83E0llEuZq18sTsl6Sws7QhHweS9l3Ux89xpIoGrgnKp_SN-NFh3uzgU8YiZblRU3hBJrffftCsaSb0zIdCJCMUwDEwbU4t-l9SfRMJr4xFkjpxwq4FWzyA) | ![](https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/L6yX0jT-bYhSn4XLtsB2jjmCHdIWMDMEF6EfqmzuD_3_9Q7DKTu_IWQdWfboncOiLVDUZ-6fTA6b5CcY5rILFTCGMpk2GjA9NTmPebmGuDc5xupldr__A_GA-DRYgXnk5lJ7uievTfgS_EXELt5Fxv0) ---|--- Render Properties of CLO3D When your Rendering Properties are established, you can then load the saved Rendering Properties without having to configure Rendering Properties every time. The loaded Rendering Properties will be saved as part of the .zprj file to be used in CLO-SET Trigger. ### [Set Webhook] #### 1\. Click 'Add trigger' under webhook section. 2\. Choose the trigger use case at which you want to fire the trigger. CLO-SET currently offers webhooks for 5 different use cases. \- Workflow: You can set a webhook to be fired at a specific Content Workflow. \- Invite / Share: You can set a webhook to be fired when a user has been invited/shared to a Space/Content. \- Content Upload: You can set a webhook to be fired when a Content is uploaded. \- Version Upload: You can set a webhook to be fired when a Version is uploaded. \- Colorway Status: You can set a webhook to be fired at a specific Colorway Status. 3\. Enter the URL that webhook will be requested. 4\. Enter the Name and Value if you want to check whether the request is valid. It will be added in HTTP header with webhook request. Webhook request body sample { "UpdateTime": "2020-07-21T06:25:09.759785Z", "UpdateUser": "hello@clo-set.com", "Topic": { "TopicId": "4ea0710a0e5f4e099d92f7a284d167f9", "Version": 1, "TopicType": 1 }, "TriggerType": 1, "TriggerOption": { "WorkflowSeq": 1679, "TriggerStatus": 1 } } Webhook body schema { "UpdateTime": { "$id": "#/properties/UpdateTime", "type": "string", "format": "date-time", "description": "The update time that trigger fired." }, "UpdateUser": { "$id": "#/properties/UpdateUser", "type": "string", "description": "Email address of user" }, "Topic": { "$id": "#/properties/Topic", "type": "object", "description": "The updated space/style information", "required": [ "TopicId", "Version", "TopicType" ], "properties": { "TopicId": { "$id": "#/properties/Topic/properties/TopicId", "type": "string", "description": "The id of updated style or space" }, "Version": { "$id": "#/properties/Topic/properties/Version", "type": "integer", "description": "Version of style. Will be '0' if topic type is not style.", "default": 0 }, "TopicType": { "$id": "#/properties/Topic/properties/TopicType", "type": "integer", "enum": [0, 1], "description": "Enum for what the topic type is. 0 is none, 1 is style.", "default": "None" } } }, "TriggerType": { "$id": "#/properties/TriggerType", "type": "integer", "enum": [0, 1], "description": "The trigger type that webhook triggered. 0 is none, 1 is workflow", "default": 0 }, "TriggerOption": { "$id": "#/properties/TriggerOption", "type": "object", "description": "The object information for trigger", "required": [ "WorkflowSeq", "TriggerStatus" ], "properties": { "WorkflowSeq": { "$id": "#/properties/TriggerOption/properties/WorkflowSeq", "type": "integer", "description": "Workflow seq that tiggered." }, "TriggerStatus": { "$id": "#/properties/TriggerOption/properties/TriggerStatus", "type": "integer", "enum": [0, 1], "description": "The changed trigger status for triggered object. 0 is none, 1 is changed", "default": 0 } } } }
content_description: This web page provides Group Admins and Operators with essential guidance on accessing and utilizing the Admin Console features, including managing API tokens, triggers, and webhook settings within the CLO-SET platform.

title: Billing Guideline
content: # **Objective** Understand how CLO-SET Group Pricing works, as well as invoices and billing. 1. Payment per Group 2. Automatic Renewal 3. Who is included in the bill? 4. Adding/Removing Users 5. What is Credit? 6. Refund 7. Example: Your Billing History Explained # **Details** ### 1\. Payment per Group * CLO-SET Pricing plan operates on a [**Group**](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185480985) level. Subscribing to the Standard or Premium plan will be applied to all members within your Group. ### 2\. Automatic Renewal * Your subscription will be renewed every month. The monthly payment amount for your subscription may vary based on the number of users within your Group. * *All renewals are made on the same day your subscription started. As an exception, if you subscribed on the 31st, renewal will be done on the last day of every month (ex. on the months with 30 days only, your renewal will be on the 30th). ### 3\. Who is included in the bill? All users invited to or shared within the Group are included in the billing. This encompasses users with the following permissions: * Group Admin * Company Admin * Company Collaborator * Brand Admin * Brand Collaborator * Editor * Viewer **Note:** Users with only Group Operator permission are excluded from billing. Find out more on Permissions [HERE](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303153376537). To view or manage your Group's permissions, please visit [Permission Management](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303195393049) tab. ### 4\. Adding/Removing users during your subscription You may need to add additional team members to your Group after your subscription has begun. * **Adding User:** Charged on the next billing cycle. Amount calculated on a daily basis. Each additional user will be charged for the # of days they were in the Group (ex. for Premium Plan: $40➗ # of days in month). * The amount will be recorded as Credit on your Group. Please see below for an example. * **Removing User** : If you delete a user during your billing cycle, the amount of unused days will be refunded in a form of Credit on your account (ex. for Premium Plan: $40 ➗ # of days in month). This additional Credit will automatically be used on your next payment. However, these addition credit cannot be transferred into cash refunds. Please see below for an example. * _Added users are billed from the day they have been added. Removed users are refunded including the day they have been removed._ _* All 'days' are counted based on the UTC timezone._ _* **Note:** The Active/Inactive status does not affect billing. It simply indicates whether a user is currently using the features. Even users marked as Inactive on the **User Activity** page are still considered paid users._ ### 5\. What is Credit? * Any changes on number of users within your Group will be reflected on your Group's Credit. All Credit Balance will be processed in your next payment. See below for examples. ### 6\. Refund * CLO-SET does not provide refunds for the subscription once it is initiated. Addition credits will be forfeited without cash refunds when downgrading to the Free plan. * Your credit balance will be retained when switching between Premium and Standard plans. ### 7\. Example: Your Billing History Explained ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777989667737) 1. **Subscription Created** : Billed for 5 users on the Premium Plan. 2. **Payment Complete** : Payment complete, subscription started for 5 users. 3. **Added 1 User to the Group:** The additional user will be billed as a prorated credit based on the number of days remaining until the renewal date. The accrued credit will be charged on the Group's next renewal date. * In this example, total credit billed is $33.10 * (Price per user / Total days in billing period) * Remaining days until renewal * ($40 / 29) * 24 = $33.10 * This amount is billed on your next renewal date. 4. **Removed 1 User from the Group:** The unused days for this member will be refunded as a credit and automatically applied to your next payment. * In this example, total credit refunded is $33.33 * (Price per user / Total days in billing period) * Remaining days until renewal * ($40 / 30) * 25 = $33.33 * This amount will automatically apply to your next payment. However, canceling your subscription (switching to the Free Plan) will forfeit this credit.
content_description: The purpose of this webpage is to provide a comprehensive overview of CLO-SET Group Pricing, including billing processes, user management, and credit handling, ensuring users understand their subscription details and financial implications.

title: Search
content: # **Objective** Find your Contents with the search feature in CLO-SET. Find it fast. Find it easy. 1. [Search Tab](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/undefined#h_01H570RFSHKRKYPQ938B1SVKTB) 2. Keyword Search 3. Image Search 4. Filters 5. View / Sort Option 6. Workroom/Assortment Search # **Details** ### 1) Search Tab * Access the Search tab from the dashboard. Click the 'Search' icon on the far left. ![Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 9.10.54 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776088187161) | ![Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 9.17.22 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776097100057) ---|--- 1. 1. Keyword search 2. Image search 3. Reset search options 4. Filter search results 5. View/Sort option ### 2) Text Search ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776112246297) Search using the Content Name, Creator, or Content ID. Please note that only the Contents to which you have access to will be displayed as the search result. ### 3) Image Search ![Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 9.56.08 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776114269721) | ![Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 9.56.38 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776128898969) ---|--- To start searching with image files, click on 'search by image' icon next to the magnifier icon. Upload an image file, and click 'Apply'. CLO-SET AI will detect the shape, color, and pattern and find similar Contents. * Start searching with image files such as: * Rendered output of your Content * Physical image of the design * Pattern images used for the Content ![CLO-SET_Default_Final_Butter.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776114562073) | ► | ![Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 10.05.37 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776145656985) ---|---|--- ### 4) Filters ![Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 10.16.15 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776098255769) Use Search filters to expand or narrow down the search results. Learn what each of the filters indicate: * [Content Type](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801): Each Content is classified as a single Content Type. You may select the Content Type at the time of upload, or CLO-SET will auto-assign one based on your file format. * [Space](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303240419865): Select a Company, Brand, or Workroom Space to conduct the search. Click on the ► icon view lower-level Spaces. Once the selection is made, click 'Next'. * User must have 'Viewer' or above permission to select the respective Space. * [Workflow](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303233641241) / [Category](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303202913049): Can only be applied once the Space selection is made. ### 5) View/Sort Option ![Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 10.27.10 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776115130649) --- Modify viewing and sorting options: * View By: * Contents: Search results will show each Content only * Colorway: Search results will show each Colorway of the Content * Sort By: * Last Modified * Name: Sorting based on the file name. * [Workflow](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303233641241): Sorting based on the Workflow steps identified from your Company Settings * Relevance : Sorts results based on how closely they match the search keyword or image ### 6) Workroom/Assortment Search Users can search for a specific Workroom or Assortment by its name. Select the 'Workroom' or 'Assortment' option from the 'Search For' drop down next to the search bar. #### **1\. In Company, Brand, Line, Season** * From the 'Search For' drop-down menu, select 'Workroom' or 'Assortment' ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776146241433) * Type in the keyword to search for Workroom/Assortment. Search results display Workroom/Assortment with names that includes your input (Do not support placeholders) * When you search for a Workroom/Assortment within a specific Space (Company, Brand, or Line), ALL associated Workrooms/Assortments within that Space will be displayed * Hover over the Workroom to view the location path ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776098799129) #### **2\. In Season** * From the 'Search For' drop-down menu, select 'Workroom' or 'Assortment' ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776146620441) * Type in the keyword to search for Workroom/Assortment. Search results display Workroom/Assortment with names that includes your input (Do not support placeholders) * When you search for a Workroom/Assortment within the selected Season * Please note that the search results will **only** display either Workrooms or Assortments per your selection. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776157509913) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776116190233) ---|--- #### **3\. In Workroom** * From the 'Search For' drop-down menu, select 'Workroom' * Contents of Current Room: search the Contents within the current level Workroom only * Contents Including Child Rooms: search the contents from the current Workroom and all its child Workrooms. * Workrooms: search the Child Workrooms within the current Workroom * Type in the keyword to search for Child Workrooms. Search results display all Child Workrooms with names that includes your input (Do not support placeholders) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776116413465)
content_description: Discover and access your content effortlessly with CLO-SET's advanced search features, including keyword, image search, and customizable filters.

title: Plan Restrictions (Measurement Standard)
content: # **Objective** Understand plan limits and how the usage fields are calculated in CLO-SET. Your Group may have limited availability on selective features. Check[ CLO-SET Pricing Page](https://style.clo-set.com/service/pricing) for more details. 1. User 2. Company & Workroom 3. File Upload 4. Rendering 5. Embed View 6. CLO-SET API 7. Usage History 8. Plan Limit Error & Upgrade # **Details** Based on your Group's usage, you may need to upgrade your plan or pay additional charges. Visit **[CLO-SET Pricing page](https://style.clo-set.com/service/pricing)** to find the full list of plan types and feature availability. ![Screenshot 2025-05-28 at 5.31.58 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47456838666137) ### ### 1) User * Free Plan: invite/share with up to 3 users * Standard/Premium Plan: invite/share unlimited number of users. Charges apply per the number of users in the Group. * Users with Admin, Collaborator, Editor, or Viewer permission to any Space within the Group will be counted towards billing. Group Operators are not included. * Review the full list of users in the Group on [Console - Settings - Permission Management](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303209418649). * If CLO employees are invited to your Group for support, they are excluded from the user count. ### 2) Company & Workroom * Free Plan: create up to 1 Company and 1 Workroom * Standard Plan: create up to 1 Company and 10 Workrooms * Premium Plan: unlimited Space creation * All Companies and [Workrooms](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303190956697) within the Group are counted, even if there is no Content uploaded within the Space. * On CLO-SET dashboard, click 'Workspace' button from the left pane. Click 'All Companies' or 'All Workrooms' to view the full list, and make changes if needed. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778415314329) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778431143577) ### 3) File Upload * Free Plan: up to 10 files uploads per month. Renewed on the 1st of each month. * Standard/Premium Plan: unlimited file uploads and storage. * All file uploads, including version uploads and deleted files, are counted. * 'Sample.zprj' file created as a default is excluded from the count. * Visit [Console - Billing - Usage History](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303239183257) to review the file upload usage for each measurement period. ### 4) [Rendering](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303207203225) * Rendering usage is based on the Render output file size. For Rendering details, visit 'Workspace - Rendering' or '[Console - Billing - Usage History](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303239183257)' * Free Plan * up to 50MB per month. Limit resets on the 1st of each month. You must upgrade your plan to use more Rendering. * Premium & Standard Plan * up to 3 GB (Premium) or 1 GB (Standard) per user in the Group each month. Limit resets on the subscription renewal date. * Additional charges apply for usage exceeding the limit. **$10 per 1 GB** will be billed on the group’s next payment. * When you add a user to the group during your subscription, we’ll adjust the usage based on the remaining days and provide a proportional amount. ### 5) [Embed Viewer](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303195817497) * The Embed Viewer count is based on the number of times end users open the Embed Viewer created from the content within your group. This includes all direct visits via the URL/QR code and access through the 3D Viewer URL embedded in your [Visual Board](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303200610841). * Visit '[Console - Billing - Usage History](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303239183257)' to view the current status. * Add-on purchase option is not available for Embed Viewer usage. Please**upgrade or add users** to the Group to allow more view counts. * Free Plan * up to 30 views per month. Limit resets on the 1st of each month. You must upgrade for additional usage. * Standard Plan * up to 100 views per user in the Group each month. Limit resets on the subscription renewal date. You must upgrade for additional usage. * Premium Plan * up to 300 views per user in the Group each month. ### 6) [CLO-SET API ](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303242212505) * CLO-SET API is available under the Premium plan or Enterprise plan only. * All API calls made for your Group will be counted, except the oAuth option. * Premium Plan * up to 300 API Calls per user in the Group each month. Limit resets on the subscription renewal date. * Additional charges apply for usage exceeding the limit. **$5 per 300 calls** will be billed on the group’s next payment. ### 7) Usage History To review your Group's feature usage, please visit [Console - Billing - Usage History](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303239183257). ### 8) Plan Limit Error & Upgrade * If your group exceeds the plan limit, you'll see an error message prompting an upgrade. * Group Admin & Group Operators * Visit [Console > Summary](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303236765721) and click 'Change Plan' to upgrade the plan * All other permission * You will not be able to upgrade the Group's plan. Please contact your Group Admin. ![Screenshot 2025-05-28 at 5.35.08 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47456812712729) ---
content_description: This web page provides essential information on CLO-SET plan limits and feature usage calculations to help users manage their subscription effectively and understand when an upgrade may be necessary.

title: Color Preset
content: #### Permission: ![Admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778536522393) Admin ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778572032281)Collaborator ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778537124889) Editor ## **Objective** ## Upload a Color Palette to be shared within your Company space. title: Render Preset
content: Render Preset option allows you to provide a uniform Render Setting as a guideline throughout the Company. #### Permission (Add/Change/Delete): ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778769749529) Company Admin #### Permission (Use): ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778769749529) Admin, ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778790058265)Collaborator, ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778755814297)Editor *See below for permission details # **Objective** * [Save as ZVRP from CLO3D](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303245952537) * [Add/Change/Delete Render Preset](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303245952537) * [Using Render Preset](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303245952537) * [Render Preset - Properties](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303245952537) # **Details** ### 1) Save as ZVRP from CLO3D * To start using the new Render Preset feature in CLO-SET, you will need a ZVRP file. ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778770413977) | ► | ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778770671897) ---|---|--- * On CLO3D software, change Render settings you'd like to save using Property Editor (Image/Video, Light, and Render) * Once you are done, click **Save As > Render Properties** to save as **ZVRP** file. * The saved ZVRP includes Image/Video, Camera, Light, and Render properties. Scroll down to #4 for the detailed list of properties to be reflected on CLO-SET Render. * A few requirements for CLO-SET: * Image count for Turntable must be less than 64 * Image size must be less than 5,000px * Animation type can not be rendered *Please note: If you select the 'Current View' option from CLO3D, CLO-SET Render will be based on the last view each user sees on their CLO-SET 3D Viewer. ### ### 2)Add/Change/Delete Render Preset * **Company Admin ONLY **\- Managing the Render Preset for each Company can only be done by the Company Admin. If you are a Collaborator or below, please contact your Admin for support. * Click on your **Company > 'Settings' > 'Rendering'** to Add/Edit/Delete Render Preset. * Click on 'Upload File' to add a Render Preset. You may add up to 32 files. ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778770876313) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778775123481) ---|--- * Click on 'Change File' to upload a new ZVRP file. This will NOT affect the previous Render output. The new setting will be used for future Render works. * Click 'Download' to save the ZVRP file. * Click on the 𝒊 icon to view the property details. * Click on X to delete the Render Preset. ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778771416729) ### 3) Using Render Preset * Editors or above can utilize the Render Preset for each Content. * On your Content Page, click on Render to select the Render Settings. * On the drop-down menu, you will see the **Company Preset** (with ![company.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778798655129) icon) * Users may save a Preset for themselves. In this case, the individual user's Preset will be shown at the bottom of the drop-down menu. ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778791857433) | ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778799099289) ---|--- * Once you select the Company's Render Preset option, you can not change the Render Settings. You may check the Property details by clicking on the 𝒊 icon. ### 4) Render Preset - Properties Please find the full list of Render Property to be reflected on CLO-SET Render. **Image/Video Property** | ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778772254233) | * Image Type (image/ turntable) * Colorway * View Point * Image Format * Image Size * Unit (px/in/mm/cm) * Resolution * Color * Texture * Crop | ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778799426073) ---|---|---|--- For Turntable Image * Image Count * Rotation Angle * Rotation Axis * Direction * Save Video * Save GIF * Total Duration * Frame Duration * Video Format | ![Screenshot 2023-12-15 at 10.35.06 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778799697817) **Light Property** | ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778792888601) | * Preset * Rectangle Light * Sphere Light * Directional Light * Spot Light * IES Light * Dome Light | ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778793061785) **Render Property** | ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778789581721) | * Noise Threshold * Seam Puckering Intensity * Light * Material * Linear Workflow * Color Mapping Type * Burn Value | ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778777338905)![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778777570841) * A few requirements for CLO-SET: * Image count for Turntable must be less than 64 * Image size must be less than 5,000px * Animation type can not be rendered *Please note: If you select the 'Current View' option from CLO3D, CLO-SET Render will be based on the last view each user sees on their CLO-SET 3D Viewer.
content_description: The Render Preset page empowers Company Admins to establish and manage standardized render settings, ensuring consistent visual output across all projects within the organization.

title: Payment Method & Process
content: # **Objective** Understand how to complete payments on CLO-SET and troubleshooting process. 1. Payment Process 2. Change Card & Billing Address 3. Troubleshooting Payments # **Details** ### 1) Payment Process 1\. Go to <https://style.clo-set.com/service/pricing>. Find plan details, and click 'Subscribe' to start. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778165209497) 2\. Start by entering your Payment information. Click on 'Enter Payment Details'. Insert card number, expiration date, security code, along with the cardholder name and address. Then, click 'Confirm'. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778187110041) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778187381401) ---|--- 3\. Once the payment info is registered, confirm billed amount, agree to the Terms, and click 'Order' to complete the payment * Subscription amount is based on the Plan Type, and the # of users in your [Group](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185480985). * If you have any carryover balance, it will be reflected on the bill as shown below (#2). ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778182229785) 4\. Once the payment is complete, you will see the below page. Start enjoying your subscription. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778172939161) ### 2) Change Card & Billing Address * To change the credit card information or billing address, visit [Console - Summary](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303236765721) page. Click 'Change' next to your payment information. * Click 'Change Card' to update card information or billing address. *Console page is accessible for Group Admin and Group Operator only. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778173122457) ### 3) Troubleshooting Payments Payment attempts may fail for several reasons. See below for a list of errors and how to resolve them. 1. [Your Group exceeds the number of Companies or Workrooms available under the plan] * This error is displayed when the Group attempts to downgrade the plan. If your Group's usage exceeds the limits of the selected plan, downgrading cannot be completed. Please[ review the limitations](https://style.clo-set.com/service/pricing) for each plan and make the necessary adjustments. Then, try downgrading again. 2. [There are Addition Credits that your Group should settle before re-subscribing] * This error is due to having unpaid credit balance on your account. As such cases need further review, please contact our [support](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new). 3. [Failed to register card information due to card issue] * Please double check your credit card information or billing address. If the issue persists, [contact us](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new). 4. [Upon upgrading, any remaining free trial period will be forfeited, and the payment will be charged immediately] * This message is not an error, but a notification. If you are currently on a Trial period, initiating a paid subscription would forfeit the remaining Trial period.
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive guide on how to complete payments on CLO-SET, including the payment process, updating billing information, and troubleshooting common issues.

title: Line Sheet - List Mode
content: ## **Objective** Enjoy an auto-generated CLO-SET Line Sheet that includes everything from Garment Thumbnail to Sales Channel and Price information! #### ✏️ Edit Permission: ![Admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778683755033)Admin, ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778637056537)Company Collaborator #### 👀 View Permission: ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778637056537)Collaborator, ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778637356953)Editor or above in respective Space ## **Detail** * What is Line Sheet List Mode? * Access & Permission * Line Sheet List Mode - Table Fields * Export to Excel * Company Settings ## ### 1) What is Line Sheet List Mode? ![Line_sheet_-_List_Mode_4x.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778684694297) CLO-SET provides an auto-generated Line Sheet from the data stored in your 3D garment. Line Sheet List Mode covers information from Thumbnail to Sales Channel, Cost, and Price for a comprehensive review and decision making. ### 2) Access & Permission You may access Line Sheet from various Space level: Company Library, Brand, Line, Season, and Workrooms. Line Sheet will cover all Contents within the respective Space. * Enter the Space > click on 'LINE SHEET' button![LineSheetAccess.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778669258777) Admin and Collaborators may **_edit_** the information within the Line Sheet. Editors or above with access to respective Space (Company, Brand, or Workroom) may **_view_** the Line Sheet. * Minimum Permission to Edit and View Line Sheet of each Space **_✏️ Edit_ Permission** | **Enter Line Sheet from :** | **_👀 View_ Permission** ---|---|--- Group Admin Company Admin Company Collaborator Brand Admin | Company Library | Brand Collaborator or above & Company Library Editor Brand | Brand Collaborator or above Line Season Workroom | Workroom Editor or above Child Workroom ### ### 3) Line Sheet List Mode - Table Fields **Field Type** | **Field List / Explanation** | **Example** ---|---|--- **Non-Editable** | * Thumbnail * Content ID * Company * Brand * Line * Season * Workroom * Creator * Date Created * Date Updated * Content Version * Size | ![nonedit1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778669524249) ![nonedit2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778662607897) Editable by **Content** | * Content No. * Content Name * Workflow * Category * Material Composition * Tag * Description * Customer Type * Product Manager | ![editableCont1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778670091161) ![editableCont2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778673532569) Editable by **Colorway** | * Colorway * Status * Carryover * Quantity * Retail Intro Date * Retail Exit Date * Development Cost * Price * Sales Channel * Store Type * Store Name * Remark | ![editableCol1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778673767833) ![editableCol2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778686472217) **Colorway No.** | This field is editable by user. Assign a unique Colorway No. for easier management. | ![Colorway_No.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778686628505) *Any changes made in Line Sheet will be reflected on the original Content and vice versa. ### 4) Export to Excel You can now export the Line Sheet to an Excel file. On the Line Sheet List Mode view, click the button below to export. ![Excel](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778686845209) ### 5) Company Settings You may customize fields including Category, Workflow, Status, etc. within your Company Settings. You will be able to use the customized options within Line Sheet. * Enter the Company Space > click on Settings ![mceclip1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778698198681) * Customizable fields: Category, Workflow, Status, Customer Type, Sales Channel and Store Type ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778687567001)
content_description: Discover how to effortlessly generate and manage your CLO-SET Line Sheet, featuring comprehensive garment details and customizable options for streamlined sales and decision-making.

title: [Enterprise Plan] Direct upload from CLO Software
content: # **Objective** For Enterprise plan users, You can directly upload a 3D project file including or excluding garment/avatar from CLO Software to CLO-SET and easily share it with other users. 1. title: Company Library
content: # **Objective** ![Size=2XL 200, RVS=OFF.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778222566297) | Company Library is a cloud repository that helps brands store, source, manage, and share essential digital contents. You can use Company Library to centralize and organize brand logo, virtual fabric/trim, block pattern, avatar/dummy, and more. ---|--- 1. Accessibility 2. Favorite 3. Search 4. Turn On/Off Company Library # **Details** ### 1) Accessibility Company Library can be accessed by both Company Admin and Collaborator as well as the Brand Admin and Brand Collaborator under that Company. But it could additionally be shared to other users as Company Library Editor or Viewer. You may think of Company Library as a**separate workspace to store/share common assets** , so the permission for Company Library is also separate from other workrooms in the Company. | Download | Upload | Delete ---|---|---|--- Company Admin / Collaborator Brand Admin / Collaborator | o | o | o Company Library Editor | o | o | x Company Library Viewer | x | x | x ## ### 2) Favorite** ** ![Screenshot 2023-07-28 at 2.20.23 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778208395417) You can designate Company Library into Favorites by clicking the icon ![blobid0.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778239133081), and enter Favorite Company Library, Workroom or content page using the Shortcut menu on the left side of the page. ### 3) Search for Content Name & ID ![Screenshot 2023-07-28 at 2.22.37 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778239244953) You can also search for Content Name or ID by using [Search](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303160683161) function on each Space page. ※Note: What is Content Type & ID? [Click here](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801) ### 4) Turn On/Off Company Library ![Screenshot 2023-07-28 at 2.23.32 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778208975385) Company Admin can turn on/off Company Library Function. ※Note: Please refer to [Company Setting](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303214894873) to manage/set Company’s space.
content_description: The Company Library webpage serves as a centralized cloud repository for brands to efficiently store, manage, and share vital digital assets while providing customizable access and organizational features.
